subject.title: [Bug]: Slack thread-session-key ACP binding routing test fails deterministically on main

question: Should the protected Slack ACP routing test failure be handled manually under the `maintainer` label, or should protection be cleared so a narrow repair can be queued after a fresh repro captures the exact mismatch?
rationale: The failure appears bounded and source-backed, but the live issue carries a protected label that this cleanup workflow must treat as an explicit human-handling signal.

options.title: Handle Under Protection
options.body: Keep the protected label and have a maintainer capture the focused failing output before fixing or assigning the Slack routing repair.

options.title: Clear For Repair Lane
options.body: Remove the protected label only after deciding that an automated narrow repair may attempt the Slack prepare-routing/test fix.

recommendation.title: Handle Under Protection
recommendation.body: Keep the protected label and have a maintainer capture the focused failing output before fixing or assigning the Slack routing repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and PR metadata tie the current Slack test/routing split to this handle, making them the best routing candidate from the available history.
